card.name: Number of divided doses per day
card.fires_on: The number word or digit (3, three, four, 4) right after "in" or "given in" in a daily-dose instruction, just before "divided doses" or "equal doses".

modes.description: A digit giving the number of doses, after "in", before "or 4 equally divided doses".

card.writes: It promotes words like equally, evenly and uniformly, predicting that the doses will be described as equal parts.
card.plain: It fires on the number of doses a daily amount is split into, where the next word is usually "equally" or "divided".
